study_design: Case-control study of prostate cancer cases and healthy controls
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 489 prostate cancer cases and 427 healthy controls were genotyped for SNPs found on chromosome 8q24 and a genetic risk score was calculated.
reason: The study assessed overall prostate cancer risk. Gleason score was examined as a clinical characteristic among cases, but the abstract does not establish an analysis of incident aggressive prostate cancer versus cancer-free controls.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Age and tobacco use were positively associated, whilst alcohol consumption was negatively associated with prostate cancer risk.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol association is with overall prostate cancer risk. The numeric OR and confidence interval come from supplied full-text evidence, but the general endpoint itself is supported by the abstract.
